<thought>To locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition, I will query the template catalog for reactions that form a new carbon‑carbon single bond (atomic numbers 6‑6) and that change a carbon‑carbon double bond to a single bond (order change 2.0→1.0). This should retrieve the appropriate Diels‑Alder template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
